title: TD Marketing chats: pin, Mark unread, two chats per lead, and the setter sees less
text: Marketing chats got the tools of a normal chat: emoji, reply, edit on your own message, Mark unread, and Pin/Unpin with an amber pinned bar at the top. A new message no longer moves a lead card to another column; the card stays in its stage with a blinking New message tag. Every lead now has two chats: Antonio with Rocco, and Rocco with the setter.
points: The setter no longer sees the seller's side of a lead: his notes, the booking and payment links, or that it was paid. Such a lead shows as With the seller.
View as now shows exactly what that role sees, and it ends by itself when Antonio opens his own Marketing section.
Voice notes in a lead chat warn "No sound yet" after a few seconds of silence and are not sent if the microphone recorded nothing.
Antonio sees his own Marketing menu on every Marketing screen; Word and Excel files open in Documents; the setter has no Documents by default.
